info.title: API.SH: Fragrantica
info.description: The Fragrantica API from API.SH: public Fragrantica data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A perfume brand on Fragrantica: id, name, url, logo, country, main activity, parent company, website, niche/celebrity/natural flags, description, and its perfumes (every search filter and sort applies; 30 a page). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fragrantica-brand

Perfume brands on Fragrantica by name (all brands without `q`), optionally niche, celebrity or natural-perfumery brands only: id, name, slug, url, parent company and the type flags. 30 a page, up to 20 pages. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

get.description:
Reviews of a perfume on Fragrantica, newest first: id, author, author profile link, avatar, date, text and the reviewer's own votes (rating, seasons, day/night, longevity, sillage, gender, owned/had/wanted). `limit` sets how many of the newest reviews to return (up to 100).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fragrantica-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Perfume id (e.g. `40069`) or its fragrantica.com/perfume/... link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.perfume: Chanel No 5 Eau de Parfum Chanel

reviews.author: hanifegulse
reviews.text: Smells like any luxurious restroom to me, not a fan.

get.description:
Perfumes on Fragrantica (fragrantica.com, the perfume encyclopedia) for keywords and every filter of the site's search page: brand, gender, notes, olfactory family, perfumer, collection, brand country, brand type, parent company, brand activity, year range, minimum votes and rating, popular only. Each perfume: `id`, `name`, `brand`, `year`, `gender`, `url`, `rating`, `votes`, `reviews`, `collection`, `perfumers`, `notes`, `family`, `image`, `thumbnail`, `popularity` and `raw`. `facets` lists the values of every filter with counts (pass a value as the filter). Several values of one filter: separate with `|` (any of them). 30 a page, up to the first 1,000 matches; `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fragrantica-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (perfume or brand name), e.g. `sauvage`. Optional.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand name as the site writes it, e.g. `Chanel` (`facets.brand`).

parameters.name: year_min
parameters.description: Launched in or after this year.

parameters.name: year_max
parameters.description: Launched in or before this year.

parameters.name: min_votes
parameters.description: At least this many rating votes.

parameters.name: popular
parameters.description: `true`: popular perfumes only (the site's "most popular" switch).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
